author: Cleo Abram
description:
They’re shutting down the biggest science experiment to build something even cooler. 

The Large Hadron Collider smashes particles together to discover new and rare ones, like the Higgs Boson. But right now, we only see the Higgs Boson in about 1 in a BILLION collisions… we need more collisions…. 

But how do they get those tiny particles to HIT EACH OTHER? To find out, subscribe!

#science #particle #physics #CERN #LHC #experiment
title: World’s Biggest Experiment is Shutting Down
